title: Write Specifications That Preserve Judgment
runtime: Python3.10+, standard library and pytest; finite schemas/fake effects, no model/network

parts.lesson_anchor: Six specification surfaces; bounded/locked/delegated; examples and preserving reasons
planted_bugs: bounded validator accepts rationale alone; compiler fails in separate compile_boundary consumer
example list nonempty but four exercise intent kinds absent
locked route loses rationale bound to decision id
ordinal catalog compilation shifts remainder with each front pop
parts.overfix_guard: numeric-free allowlist valid, delegated rationale may be empty, duplicate catalog occurrences preserved, original units retained

parts.lesson_anchor: Specifications evolve; preserve why constrained choices exist
parts.storage: append-only JSON Lines contiguous decision revisions
parts.exactness: typed Decision/Boundary, raw rationale/mode/question/unit text and exact float values, None-vs-empty update semantics; Unicode U+2028/U+0085 remain string data using supplied physical-line reader
traps: None preserves rationale but empty replaces
mode/boundary updates preserve other field; explicit None clears boundary; duplicate/gap revisions rejected

parts.lesson_anchor: Proof Must Match the Claim; examples do not replace invariants
parts.algorithm: exact kind-role mapping plus required receipt bindings, case union and authority scope
traps: finite case coverage only from valid receipts
every required receipt valid, first-error priority and exact authority scope even extra permissions

parts.lesson_anchor: Human checkpoints for locked; explicit bounded limits; delegated reversible choice
parts.wire_format: private NDJSON event/decision/reasons packets, supplied encoder
traps: locked checkpoint before effect outranks budgets
any global sources/retries/elapsed budget at threshold blocks; simultaneous reasons combined
continue applies once then yields; terminal/cancel has no future pulls

parts.lesson_anchor: Explicit limits and known safe choices preserve bounded judgment
traps: passing ANY hides failed sibling blockers
all actual failing occurrence paths in DFS order
root empty path and repeated metric positions

deviations: Decision ids and typed Boundary fields make limits executable; allowed dependency/interface families are valid without numbers. Mode/type/schema/unit helpers are supplied correct.

Normal/edge/failure/forbidden coverage is a stricter exercise requirement drawn from prose advice. The original one-normal example passes its original tests; this is not a claim that source already enforces all four.

Ordinal allowlist catalog compilation is a finite policy representation, benchmarked narrowly to expose front-removal cost without full asdict overhead. It is not another linear-name-lookup-to-dict-index exercise.
JSONL revisions preserve rationale evolution rather than overwriting the source JSON contract; contiguous revision ids and explicit None-versus-empty updates are exercise rules.
Proof kinds are exact role matches, not a total freely substitutable hierarchy. Finite cases and authority scope make coverage machine-checkable without claiming universal safety.

Part4 uses a private NDJSON format and cumulative completed-work/elapsed snapshots with an injected local apply fake. No JSON-RPC method or external SDK stop/checkpoint semantics are invented. Global budget priority and current-choice allowlists are explicit exercise rules.
Part5 is a finite structured all/any/limit/allowed AST (valid depth at most20), with schema and leaf evaluation supplied; it does not require a natural-language compiler.

Supplied JSONL reader uses UTF-8 physical file lines, preserving Unicode line separators inside question/rationale. The round-trip and revert-splitlines guard protect the correct helper; this is not a candidate primary defect.
